capabilities: Deliver captures to an inbox or daily note
Capture from selected notes, text, or files
extras: Freemium: paid credits are bought through Constance (via Paddle, USD) with a free allowance. Core capture runs locally, but account/billing data goes to Constance and error reports to Datadog.
problem: Obsidian has no fast way to jot fleeting thoughts and route them into an inbox or daily note without leaving the current note.

relations.evidence: Connect your Constance account in plugin settings.
New purchases use Paddle and USD.
plugin error reports sent to Datadog

summary: Quick capture plugin that saves text locally and delivers it to a configured inbox or daily note.
